title: ARNAI: Artifact Removal Network based on Autoencoding and Inpainting for Robust Spinal Image Segmentation and Measurement
abstract: arXiv:2609.07013v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Purpose: This study aims to develop an AI framework applicable for postoperative imaging for automated measurement of spinopelvic parameters on radiographs with robustness to the presence of spinal implants.   Materials and Methods: We retrospectively reviewed lateral lumbar spine radiographs from two institutions (Internal: January 2017--December 2024; External: October 2021--September 2025). We developed the Restore, Segment, and Measure (RSM) framework, incorporating a novel Artifact Removal Network based on Autoencoding and Inpainting (ARNAI) to mitigate implant-related artifacts in postoperative radiographs. Segmentation and spinopelvic parameter (PT, LL, SS, SCA) measurement performance were assessed using Wilcoxon signed-rank tests and intraclass correlation coefficients.   Results: When ARNAI was added to a recent Transformer-based segmentation model, FCBFormer, the mean DSC increased to 0.870 from 0.814, with marked gains at L

translated_title: ARNAI：基于自编码与图像修复的伪影去除网络，用于鲁棒的脊柱图像分割与测量
translated_abstract: 目的：本研究旨在开发一种适用于术后影像的人工智能框架，用于在X光片上自动测量骨盆-脊柱参数，并对脊柱植入物的存在具有鲁棒性。材料与方法：我们回顾性分析了来自两家机构的腰椎侧位X光片（内部机构：2017年1月至2024年12月；外部机构：2021年10月至2025年9月）。我们开发了“恢复、分割与测量”（RSM）框架，其中引入了一种新颖的基于自编码与图像修复的伪影去除网络（ARNAI），用于减轻术后X光片中与植入物相关的伪影。采用Wilcoxon符号秩检验和组内相关系数评估了分割及骨盆-脊柱参数（PT、LL、SS、SCA）的测量性能。结果：当将ARNAI加入到近期基于Transformer的分割模型FCBFormer中时，平均DSC从0.814提升至0.870，在腰椎节段处获得了显著提升。
tldr: 本研究提出了基于自编码与图像修复技术的伪影去除网络ARNAI，可有效去除术后脊柱X光片中的植入物伪影，显著提升了脊柱分割及骨盆-脊柱参数自动测量的准确性与鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: This study proposes ARNAI, an artifact removal network based on autoencoding and inpainting, which effectively mitigates implant-related artifacts in postoperative spinal radiographs, significantly enhancing the accuracy and robustness of spinal segmentation and automated spinopelvic parameter measurement.
